definitions.explanation: A person who has reached maturity.

examples.japanese: {大人|おとな}2{人|にん}と{子供|こども}1{人|にん}
{大人|おとな}の{切符|きっぷ}は{千|せん}{円|えん}です。
{早|はや}く{大人|おとな}になりたいと{思|おも}っていたが、{今|いま}は{子供|こども}の{時|とき}に{戻|もど}りたい。
examples.english: I used to want to grow up quickly, but now I want to go back to being a child.

notes:
{大人|おとな} means adult and is used both literally (a grown person) and figuratively (mature, sensible behavior). The reading おとな is irregular — the kanji would normally read だいじん or たいじん.

USAGE:
{大人|おとな} often implies maturity and composure beyond just age. Saying {大人|おとな}だね can mean "that's mature of you" as a compliment.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {大人|おとな}になる: to grow up, to become an adult
- {大人|おとな}っぽい: mature, adult-like
- {大人|おとな}{料金|りょうきん}: adult price/fare
- {大人|おとな}しい: gentle, well-behaved (a separate word, not directly related)

CONTRAST:
- {大人|おとな}: adult (general)
- {子供|こども}: child
- {成人|せいじん}: adult in the legal sense (used in {成人式|せいじんしき}, coming-of-age ceremony)
- {若者|わかもの}: young person
- お{年寄|としよ}り: elderly person
